description: Find the ISO 8601 week number for a date. Dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format and default to today. ISO weeks run Monday to Sunday and week 1 holds the year's first Thursday. Returns the week number, ISO year, and the Monday and Sunday of that week. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/week-number/

date.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

name: hopi_week_number

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: What week number is it?
